title: Panasonic Lumix G97 Hybrid MFT Camera
purpose: Agile documentary travel, environmental portraiture, and hybrid cinematic video capture powered by a 20.3MP Live MOS sensor without low-pass filter, 5-axis Dual I.S. 2, and Leica DG high-microcontrast optics.

sensor_and_optics.camera_system: Panasonic Lumix G97 Hybrid (20.3MP Micro Four Thirds)
sensor_and_optics.sensor_type: 20.3MP Micro Four Thirds Digital Live MOS sensor without low-pass filter with Venus Engine
sensor_and_optics.sensor_dimensions: 17.4x13.0mm Micro Four Thirds sensor (2.0x crop factor)
sensor_and_optics.full_frame_equivalent: 24-120mm equivalent travel documentary field of view
sensor_and_optics.lens: Leica DG Vario-Elmarit 12-60mm f/2.8-4.0 ASPH POWER O.I.S. (24-120mm FF equivalent)
sensor_and_optics.dynamic_range: 13.0 stops dynamic range with 12-bit RAW and pre-installed V-Log L profile
sensor_and_optics.shutter: Electromagnetic drive focal-plane mechanical shutter to 1/4000s, electronic shutter to 1/16,000s, 5-axis Dual I.S. 2 (5.0 stops)

lighting_and_exposure.primary_lighting: Available documentary daylight, artisan workshop ambient, or golden travel sunset light
lighting_and_exposure.light_transport: Signature Leica optical micro-contrast, wide V-Log L highlight latitude, smooth midtone transitions with rich dimensional modeling

surface_rendering: Crisp edge acutance from Leica-certified optics: tactile woodworking shavings, woven textiles, weathered stone surfaces, and natural human skin pores without digital oversharpening
Cinematic color science with natural, balanced skin tones and faithful environmental ambiance
Clean sensor demosaicing with subtle organic noise texture in deep shadows
depth_and_optics: Controlled Micro Four Thirds depth of field providing balanced subject pop at f/2.8 while maintaining legible background storytelling context
Immaculate optical correction with zero spherical aberration or optical low-pass smearing
Documentary eye-level or chest-level angle capturing authentic human craftsmanship and cultural narratives

execution_directive: Enforce 20.3MP Micro Four Thirds hybrid documentary capture, Leica DG optical acutance, V-Log L tonal gradations, authentic cultural textures, and balanced storytelling depth of field, shot on Panasonic Lumix G97.
